name: vibedev_rail_reply_admitted_not_started
content: Your build is recorded but it has not started yet.

Task {task_id} is durably admitted — the whole run, including what to build, is on disk — so nothing is lost and sending the same message again will not create a second run. It gets started by whoever is already holding it, and at the latest the next time the service restarts. Watch the task card for {task_id}.

metadata.description: Assistant reply when a `@vibedev` turn durably admitted its run but did not reach dispatch — the claim was lost to another worker, or a retry replayed an intent that has not been started yet. Deliberately distinct from both neighbours: the start-failure reply promises `Nothing was left running`, which is false here, and the started reply says the task is running, which is also false.
